caption: Keep your application statuses private by default. JobRez maintains application tracker statuses including Saved, Applied, Interviewing, Offer, and Closed, which are stored locally in the browser. Pair this local storage model with one honest master resume, branched for every role and matched to real postings, keeping your active pipeline secure on your machine. Learn more about application tracking and master resume branching at https://jobrez.com.
